why: The one in-scope metric with no page anywhere in the system. D-RNA-01 makes rooms available a property attribute rather than a reservation one, so its source is a per-date CSV - and an answer that cites a PDF page for it has invented a page. This is the case `InventoryCitation` exists for: without it the agent could cite only the workbook side of the one finding whose source is not a report.

input.question: Where did the January rooms available figure come from?

expect.echoes_question: Where did the January rooms available figure come from?

expect_example.question: Where did the January rooms available figure come from?
expect_example.prose: F-0001 was checked against the room inventory reference for the quarter, not against the reservation report - rooms available is a property attribute and does not appear in a reservation export (D-RNA-01). The claim itself was read from the workbook's Occupancy sheet.

counterexample.question: Where did the January rooms available figure come from?
counterexample.prose: It came from page 1 of the January report, rows 1 to 31.
